title: Prices for common services
purpose: Menu prices a customer may be told without seeing the car; public version of the price list.
facts: The table repeats the current list (after the rise) for vehicle class car, standard tier unless stated.

Sales tax on parts and labour, 9.25 % at the two Chattanooga shops and 9.75 % at Charlotte Pike (ledger tax.rate.main, .east, .west); shop supplies 5 % of hourly labour, cap 35.00 USD per bill; menu-priced services carry none (catalogue configurations.en).
No repair is quoted unseen: the public page gives menu services only.

rows.Service: Full synthetic oil and filter change, up to 5 quarts
Steering and suspension inspection (noise or vibration)
Check engine light diagnosis, first hour
Pre-purchase inspection with road test and written report

list_items.section: What is added to a bill
list_items.item: Tennessee sales tax on parts and labour: 9.25 % at East Main and Bonny Oaks, 9.75 % at Charlotte Pike.

list_items.section: What is added to a bill
list_items.item: Shop supplies on repair work: 5 % of the labour, never more than $35.00 on one bill. Menu services in the table above carry none.

list_items.section: What is added to a bill
list_items.item: New tires carry a disposal fee and the state tire fee.

notes_for_russian_writer: Russian menu: fixed prices exist for tyre fitting, alignment and diagnostics; oil service is priced by the hour there (catalogue ru). VAT 5 % is inside every Russian price and nothing is added on top (ledger tax.ru_price_basis); say so once.
Shop supplies in Russia: 3 % of hourly work, at most 500 RUB.
